## bondar

A standalone devcontainer alternative that does not depend on Node.js or VSCode Server.

### Downloads

Prebuilt binaries for Linux (x86_64/aarch64), macOS (x86_64/aarch64) and Windows (x86_64) are attached to this release, alongside SHA256SUMS checksums.

### Installation

```sh
# Linux / macOS
chmod +x bondar-linux-x86_64
sudo mv bondar-linux-x86_64 /usr/local/bin/bondar
```
